embeds.title: GEN 1:1
embeds.description: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

embeds.title: GEN 1:2
embeds.description: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

embeds.title: GEN 1:3
embeds.description: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

embeds.title: GEN 1:4
embeds.description: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.

embeds.title: GEN 1:5
embeds.description: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.

embeds.title: GEN 1:6
embeds.description: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.

embeds.title: GEN 1:7
embeds.description: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.

embeds.title: GEN 1:8
embeds.description: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.

embeds.title: GEN 1:9
embeds.description: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.

embeds.title: GEN 1:10
embeds.description: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
